dedupe_keys.name: understanding the impacts of the covid 19 pandemic on public transportation travel patterns in the city of lisbon

description: The completed study combines statistical analysis with order-preserving pattern discovery to assess changes in Lisbon bus, tram and subway journeys during COVID-19. It identifies geographically imbalanced demand changes, including shifts toward peripheral areas, beyond simple local changes in total ridership. Related published maps compare 2019 and 2020 CARRIS/METRO usage and are a separate data product. The project catalogue confirms that underlying fare validations are restricted by NDA. The study’s significance and interpretability claims are reported within its data and method, without a general causal attribution of every change or a current-demand forecast. Coverage is limited to the source-described systems and experiments. The related Zenodo deposit provides descriptive metadata, with open document or data access and licence label cc-by-4.0. Document rights do not establish software rights or access to the underlying observations. Only full descriptive metadata, file inventories and the project metadata catalogue were reviewed; no underlying measurements, code, paper or model archive was opened.
